a.lede: The largest crypto theft to date was pulled off by combining some well-known hacking techniques over the course of a few months, according to Binance. A postmortem from the company says the process started in June with one developer downloading a tampered installer apparently spread by a malicious Google ad, exposing details about the engineers […]
a.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an internal AI tool to pull off the $6.3 billion heist

b.lede: Binance has revealed how Norh Korean attackers spent months compromising systems and employees with malicious developer software and a fake recruitment process. The intrusions eventually gave hackers access to the exchange’s internal wallet signing systems, enabling the October 29 theft.
b.title: Binance heist began with fake job interviews and a malicious Homebrew download
